name: wayfinder-adoption
description: Shadow-to-live adoption workflow for Wayfinder. deps are execution edges; transitions are control edges and may point backwards.

nodes.summary: Install into shadow mode and confirm the hook is wired for all seven harnesses.
nodes.evidence: install.sh --dry-run reports each harness; suggestions.jsonl begins receiving rows

nodes.summary: Catalog loads from SKILL.md and every prompt reaching a harness is byte-identical to the pre-install prompt.
nodes.pass_condition: Catalog loads; prompt digests match pre-install digests across all harnesses
nodes.fail_action: Rollback to shadow; do not iterate further

nodes.summary: The live note text equals the shadow suggestion for the same prompt, case for case.
nodes.pass_condition: Byte-equal live note and shadow suggestion over the same prompt set
nodes.fail_action: Rollback; fix in shadow before any live enablement

nodes.summary: p95 prompt-time overhead stays under the adapter's remaining budget.
nodes.pass_condition: p95 overhead under budget, measured over >=100 prompts
nodes.fail_action: Rollback; ranking must move off the prompt path

nodes.summary: All three shadow gates pass. Admission to live is gated on all three, not any one.
nodes.fail_action: Admit nothing; the first failing gate has already routed to rollback

nodes.summary: Review real shadow suggestions over N days of genuine prompts.
nodes.evidence: suggestions.jsonl pick distribution; outcomes.jsonl use rate

nodes.summary: Fix the SKILL.md descriptions the review exposed.
Enable live for exactly one harness.
The note is present in the agent's received context and was read.
nodes.pass_condition: Note observed in received context on one harness
nodes.fail_action: Return that harness to shadow; do not expand

nodes.summary: Verify live reach on Claude Code.
Verify live reach on Codex CLI.
Verify live reach on Kimi Code.
Verify live reach on Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Pi, and Hermes.
Every harness verified independently. The join is what admits the fleet-wide live state.
Monitor pick rate, accuracy, and p95 across the fleet.
Return every affected harness to shadow. Reachable only through control edges.
nodes.evidence: mode files read shadow; hook emits {}
